title: 80-million-year-old snake fossil sheds light on why lizards lost their limbs and started slithering
description: Snakes lost their limbs millions of years ago to become undulating, scaly tubes of muscles. Scientists are finally figuring out why.

title: Fossil Group, Inc. Announces Date for Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
description: RICHARDSON, Texas, July 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Fossil Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: FOSL) announced today that it will report second quarter 2026 financial results after market close on Wednesday, August 12, 2026, followed by a conference call to discuss the results at 5:00 p.m. ET the same day. The call can be accessed live on the Company’s investor relations website at www.fossilgroup.com/investors and will also be archived for replay.

title: A Google Maps search may have uncovered an ancient meteorite crater
